summary: A residential/hotel swimming pool: an 8 x 4 m tiled basin with 1.0 m shallow end, a ramp to a 1.6 m deep end… options tiles, deck, access; sockets socket_water, socket_ladder, socket_deck_front.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.swimming_pool or place "prefab": "swimming_pool" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
